summary: XTL Biopharmaceuticals filed a Form 6-K reporting that external director Ms. Iris Shapira Yalon resigned on October 12, 2026, for personal reasons and not due to any disagreement with the Company. Her resignation takes effect upon the earlier of a successor's appointment by shareholders or November 20, 2026. On October 14, 2026, the Board nominated Mr. Gilai Dolev for election as an external director for an initial three-year term, subject to shareholder approval under Section 239(b) of the Israeli Companies Law. A general meeting and proxy statement will follow on Form 6-K. The event is a routine board succession, not a forced or abrupt departure constituting a special situation.
